tool.name: ParaFEM Mesh NSET Preview
tool.description: Visualize named node sets (NSETs) as VTU for verification

param.name: nset_file
param.label: Node Sets (.nset)
param.help: The node sets file generated by Mesh Import.

tool.help:
This tool generates a VTK Unstructured Grid (.vtu) file that allows you to visually verify the named node sets (NSETs) in your mesh before applying boundary conditions.
The output VTU file contains a "SurfaceID" field at each node. Each NSET is assigned a unique integer ID. When viewed in ParaView, you can color the mesh by "SurfaceID" to see where each named set is located.
**Usage:** 1. Run "ParaFEM Mesh Import" on your Abaqus .inp file. 2. Run this tool on the resulting .d and .nset files. 3. Download the .vtu and open it in ParaView. 4. Color by "SurfaceID" and use the "Threshold" filter if needed to isolate specific surfaces.
